title: Credit for fills still authorized when replacing Prescriptions & Renewals medication
content:
**Medication Management Office standard — Prescriptions & Renewals replacement fills.**

**1. The credit.** The fills the prescription still authorizes are credited against the lost supply, because they remain available to the patient: where at least one fill remains and the expiration date is more than one per-fill days' supply away, the credit is the fills remaining multiplied by the per-fill days' supply; where at least one fill remains but the expiration date is no more than one per-fill days' supply away, the credit is the smaller of the days to the expiration date and one per-fill days' supply; where no fill remains, there is no credit (0 days).

**2. Definitions.**
2.1 *Fills remaining* — the fills the prescription still authorizes on the day of the replacement, as the prescription record shows them.
2.2 *Per-fill days' supply* — the per-fill days' supply recorded on the prescription.
2.3 *Days to the expiration date* — the number of calendar days by which the expiration date falls after the day of the replacement.
2.4 *More than one per-fill days' supply away* — the days to the expiration date exceed the per-fill days' supply; equal days fall under the second branch.

**3. Branches.**

| Fills remaining | Days to the expiration date compared with one per-fill days' supply | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 1 or more | more | fills remaining multiplied by the per-fill days' supply |
| 1 or more | equal or fewer | the smaller of the days to the expiration date and one per-fill days' supply |
| none | — | 0 days |

**4. Worked cases (hypothetical).**
- 2 fills of 30 days remain and the expiration date is 100 days away: credit 60 days.
- 2 fills of 30 days remain and the expiration date is 31 days away: still more than one per-fill supply away, credit 60 days.
- 2 fills of 30 days remain and the expiration date is 30 days away: second branch, credit 30 days.
- 1 fill of 30 days remains and the expiration date is 12 days away: credit 12 days.
- No fill remains: credit 0 days.
